about: 공지사항 [조회] 'R'(원본 E200080) — 글을 열면 조회자로 남고, 'R' 을 누르면 '조회자 현황'(왼쪽 ▸ 미조회자 [이름], 오른쪽 ▸ 조회자 [이름][최초조회일시][최종조회일시], [닫기]). 시험 글은 API 로 만들고 지운다. node qa/shot.mjs qa/flows/notice-readers.json

shots.name: 준비
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const r = await (await fetch('/api/work-posts', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ board: 'NOTICE', title: 'QA그룹웨어-조회자', content: 'QA' }) })).json(); sessionStorage.setItem('qaRd', r.id); return 'post ' + r.id })()

shots.name: 읽기 전 → 제목을 열고 → R
steps: expect:(() => { const m = document.querySelector('[role=dialog][aria-label="조회자 현황"]'); return !!m && m.innerText.includes('▸ 미조회자') && m.innerText.includes('▸ 조회자') && [...m.querySelectorAll('table')][1].innerText.includes('등록된 데이터가 없습니다.') })()

js:document.querySelector('[role=dialog] [aria-label="닫기"], [role=dialog] button[title="닫기"]')?.click(); [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog] button')].filter((b) => b.textContent.trim() === '닫기').forEach((b) => b.click()); true

expect:(() => { const m = document.querySelector('[role=dialog][aria-label="조회자 현황"]'); const rows = [...[...m.querySelectorAll('table')][1].querySelectorAll('tbody tr')]; return rows.length === 1 && /\d{4}\/\d{2}\/\d{2} \(.\) (오전|오후) \d{1,2}:\d{2}:\d{2}/.test(rows[0].cells[1].textContent) && [...m.querySelectorAll('thead th')].map((t) => t.textContent.trim()).join(',') === '이름,이름,최초조회일시,최종조회일시' })()

expect:(() => { const m = document.querySelector('[role=dialog][aria-label="조회자 현황"]'); const me = [...[...m.querySelectorAll('table')][1].querySelectorAll('tbody tr')][0].cells[0].textContent.trim(); return ![...[...m.querySelectorAll('table')][0].querySelectorAll('tbody td')].some((td) => td.textContent.trim() === me) })()

shots.name: 정리
steps: js:fetch('/api/work-posts/' + sessionStorage.getItem('qaRd'), { method: 'DELETE', headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') } }).then((r) => 'del ' + r.status)
